deploybot: :rotating_light: Release v2025.03.12 hold - preflight env-parity failed: inference prewarm requires file-based SA creds (prod=true, staging=false).
deploybot: Check failed -> `prewarm.service_account_file_exists` (expected /etc/creds/service.json).

emma: copying in - what's the delta between prod/staging secrets?
raj: prod mounts k8s secret `infer-sa-key` as a file. staging is relying on workload identity (no key file). The new prewarm job changed to explicit file lookup.
olga: ahh yeah the chart default flipped `prewarm.enable_keyfile: true` in this release. Staging values were left as false.

emma: we should not copy prod keys into staging. options: hotpatch chart to accept token fallback, provision a limited staging SA key, or rollback image.
raj: chart hotpatch is invasive; rollback is fastest to meet the change window. But we can create a limited staging key and inject it into staging secrets for the prewarm pod only. That seems low-risk.

release-coordinator: window ends in ~70m. Recommend fastest safe path. If creating test SA, need infra signoff and a note in release docs.
emma: I can own creating a scoped SA with minimal perms (s3:GetObject) and rotate the key. Should be ~25-40m.

olga: I'll prepare a helm overlay to mount `staging-infer-key` secret into `prewarm` job only, no code changes. Keep rollback plan to revert to v2025.03.09 image.

raj: infra, @olga please approve the SA with read-only cache access. Also ensure TTL on the key short-lived.
olga: approved. creating service account and key now. tagging :hourglass:.

emma: once key is ready I'll push secret manifest (redacted) and kick a canary deploy to prewarm job. smoke: `kubectl run -i --rm --restart=Never curl --image=radial/busyboxplus:curl -- /bin/sh -c "sleep 2; kubectl exec prewarm-0 -- cat /etc/creds/service.json | jq -r .project_id"`

deploybot: release paused. next auto-check at 1761007420.

olga: secret `staging-infer-key` applied to staging namespace. overlay PR open: mounts file at `/etc/creds/service.json` for prewarm job only.
emma: canary deploy started. logs: prewarm-0 init -> mounted service.json present. `jq` check returns `redwood-staging`. prewarm fetched 2MB worth of cache objects successfully.

raj: risk note: test SA only has s3:GetObject scoped to cache-bucket-staging and IAM limited to only TokenCreator? no. only storage. keys will be rotated and short TTL.

release-coordinator: decision: resume release with injected staging SA for prewarm, track follow-up to make prewarm fallback tolerant and add parity gate to releasecheck. Vote: resume?
olga: yes, resume. keep rollback instructions in release notes.
emma: adding release note: "Hold applied due to env parity on inference prewarm; temporary staging SA injected; release resumed after canary validation. Follow-up INF-431 to add parity test and fallback."

deploybot: resume accepted by release-coordinator. Release continues. :white_check_mark:

raj: postmortem follow-ups: (1) add releasecheck that compares `prewarm.enable_keyfile` flag between envs, (2) add canary smoke that verifies `/etc/creds/service.json` presence when enabled, (3) add automation to create ephemeral test SA for staging when needed.
olga: filing INF-431 and INF-432 for the workitems.
emma: keeping rollback command in notes: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-server inference=redwood/inference:v2025.03.09` and deploybot rollback steps.
